```typescriptreact
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Modal, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, Alert, FlatList, TouchableWithoutFeedback, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, Keyboard } from 'react-native';
import PresetButton from '../components/PresetButton';
import { defaultPresets, getFavoritePresets, addFavoritePreset, removeFavoritePreset } from '../storage/presets';
import { PresetDrink } from '../types/preset';
import { addDrink, addOrMergeDrink, getDrinksByDate, removeDrink } from '../storage/drinks';
import { calculateStandardUnits, todayISO, formatTotalVolume } from '../utils/units';
import { Drink } from '../types/drink';
import { useFocusEffect } from '@react-navigation/native';

export default function TodayScreen() {
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState<PresetDrink[]>([]);
  const [modalVisible, setModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [newType, setNewType] = useState<PresetDrink['beverageType']>('beer');
  const [newVolume, setNewVolume] = useState('500');
  const [newAbv, setNewAbv] = useState('5');

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const favs = await getFavoritePresets();
      setFavorites(favs);
    })();
  }, []);

  const presets = useMemo(() => {
    return [...defaultPresets, ...favorites];
  }, [favorites]);

  const [qtyModal, setQtyModal] = useState<{ visible: boolean; preset: PresetDrink | null; qty: string }>({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const openQtyModal = (preset: PresetDrink) => {
    setQtyModal({ visible: true, preset, qty: '1' });
  };

  const closeQtyModal = () => setQtyModal({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const confirmAddWithQty = async () => {
    if (!qtyModal.preset) return;
    const qtyNum = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(qtyModal.qty) || 1));
    const baseUnits = calculateStandardUnits(qtyModal.preset.volumeMl, qtyModal.preset.abvPercent);
    const totalUnits = Math.round(baseUnits * qtyNum * 100) / 100;
    const entry: Drink = {
      id: `drink_${Date.now()}`,
      dateISO: todayISO(),
      name: qtyModal.preset.name,
      beverageType: qtyModal.preset.beverageType,
      volumeMl: qtyModal.preset.volumeMl,
      abvPercent: qtyModal.preset.abvPercent,
      standardUnits: totalUnits,
      quantity: qtyNum,
    };
    await addOrMergeDrink(entry);
    closeQtyModal();
    Alert.alert('Добавлено', `${qtyModal.preset.name}: ${qtyNum} ед. (~${totalUnits} std)`);
    await reloadToday();
  };

  const openAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(true);
  const closeAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(false);

  const saveFavorite = async () => {
    const volume = parseFloat(newVolume);
    const abv = parseFloat(newAbv);
    if (!newName || isNaN(volume) || isNaN(abv)) {
      Alert.alert('Ошибка', 'Заполните название, объём и крепость');
      return;
    }
    const updated = await addFavoritePreset({
      name: newName,
      beverageType: newType,
      volumeMl: volume,
      abvPercent: abv,
    });
    setFavorites(updated);
    setNewName('');
    setNewType('beer');
    setNewVolume('500');
    setNewAbv('5');
    closeAddFavorite();
  };

  const [todayList, setTodayList] = useState<Drink[]>([]);
  const totalUnits = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.standardUnits, 0), [todayList]);
  const totalVolumeMl = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.volumeMl * (d.quantity ?? 1), 0), [todayList]);

  const reloadToday = useCallback(async () => {
    const list = await getDrinksByDate(todayISO());
    setTodayList(list);
  }, []);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      reloadToday();
    }, [reloadToday])
  );

  const onRemoveDrink = async (id: string) => {
    Alert.alert('Удалить запись?', 'Это действие нельзя отменить', [
      { text: 'Отмена', style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: 'Удалить',
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: async () => {
          await removeDrink(id);
          await reloadToday();
        },
      },
    ]);
  };

  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setEditMode(true);
  };

  const onRemoveFavorite = async (id: string) => {
    const updated = await removeFavoritePreset(id);
    setFavorites(updated);
    setEditMode(false);
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Text style={styles.title}>Сегодня</Text>
      <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Быстрые пресеты</Text>
      <View style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.presetList}>
          {presets.map((p) => {
            const panResponder = createPanResponder(p.id);
            const isDragging = draggingPreset === p.id;
            const pan = getOrCreatePanAnim(p.id);
            const isFav = p.id.startsWith('fav_');
            
            return (
              <Animated.View
                key={p.id}
                style={[
                  { position: 'relative' },
                  isFav && {
                    transform: [{ translateX: pan.x }, { translateY: pan.y }],
                  },
                ]}
                {...(panResponder?.panHandlers || {})}
              >
                <TouchableOpacity
                  style={[styles.presetButton, isDragging && styles.presetDragging]}
                  onPress={() => !isDragging && openQtyModal(p)}
                  onLongPress={() => isFav && handleLongPress(p.id)}
                  delayLongPress={500}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.presetText}>{p.name}</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </Animated.View>
            );
          })}
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.addFavButtonRect} onPress={openAddFavorite} accessibilityLabel="Добавить любимый">
            <Text style={styles.addFavRectText}>+</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </ScrollView>
        {showTrash && (
          <View
            ref={trashRef}
            style={styles.trashIcon}
            collapsable={false}
          >
            <Text style={styles.trashIconText}>🗑️</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.sectionHeaderRow}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Сегодняшние записи</Text>
        <View style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
          <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {formatTotalVolume(totalVolumeMl, 1)}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {totalUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
      <FlatList
        data={todayList}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View style={styles.listItem}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.itemTitle}>{item.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.itemSub}>
                {formatTotalVolume(item.volumeMl, item.quantity ?? 1)} · {item.abvPercent}% · {item.standardUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.
                {item.quantity && item.quantity > 1 ? ` (x${item.quantity})` : ''}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => onRemoveDrink(item.id)} style={styles.deleteBtn}>
              <Text style={styles.deleteText}>Удалить</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}
        ListEmptyComponent={<Text style={{ color: '#666' }}>Пока нет записей за сегодня</Text>}
        contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 24 }}
      />

      {/* Модалка количества единиц перед добавлением */}
      <Modal visible={qtyModal.visible} animationType="fade" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.centerBackdrop}>
            <View style={styles.centerCard}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Сколько единиц?</Text>
              {qtyModal.preset && (
                <Text style={{ marginBottom: 8, color: '#666' }}>{qtyModal.preset.name}</Text>
              )}
              <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String(Math.max(1, (parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) - 1)) }))}
                  style={[styles.cancelBtn, { marginRight: 8 }]}
                >
                  <Text>-</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TextInput
                  value={qtyModal.qty}
                  onChangeText={(t) => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: t.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') }))}
                  keyboardType="number-pad"
                  style={[styles.input, { width: 100, textAlign: 'center' }]}
                  returnKeyType="done"
                  onSubmitEditing={confirmAddWithQty}
                />
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String((parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) + 1) }))}
                  style={[styles.saveBtn, { marginLeft: 8, backgroundColor: '#eee' }]}
                >
                  <Text>+</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeQtyModal}>
                  <Text>Отмена</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={confirmAddWithQty}>
                  <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Добавить</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>

      <Modal visible={modalVisible} animationType="slide" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
            <KeyboardAvoidingView
              behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
              keyboardVerticalOffset={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 64 : 0}
              style={styles.kav}
            >
              <View style={styles.modalCard}>
                <ScrollView keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
                  <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Новый любимый напиток</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    placeholder="Название (например, Пиво 500 мл)"
                    placeholderTextColor="#888"
                    value={newName}
                    onChangeText={setNewName}
                    style={styles.input}
                    returnKeyType="done"
                    blurOnSubmit
                    onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                  />
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <Text style={styles.label}>Тип:</Text>
                    <View style={styles.typeRow}>
                      {(['beer','wine','spirit','cocktail','other'] as const).map((t) => (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          key={t}
                          style={[styles.typeChip, newType === t && styles.typeChipActive]}
                          onPress={() => setNewType(t)}
                        >
                          <Text style={styles.typeChipText}>{t}</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      ))}
                    </View>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Объём, мл"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newVolume}
                      onChangeText={setNewVolume}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1, marginRight: 8 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Крепость, %"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newAbv}
                      onChangeText={setNewAbv}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeAddFavorite}>
                      <Text>Отмена</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={saveFavorite}>
                      <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Сохранить</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
                </ScrollView>
              </View>
            </KeyboardAvoidingView>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Modal, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, Alert, FlatList, TouchableWithoutFeedback, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, Keyboard } from 'react-native';
import PresetButton from '../components/PresetButton';
import { defaultPresets, getFavoritePresets, addFavoritePreset, removeFavoritePreset } from '../storage/presets';
import { PresetDrink } from '../types/preset';
import { addDrink, addOrMergeDrink, getDrinksByDate, removeDrink } from '../storage/drinks';
import { calculateStandardUnits, todayISO, formatTotalVolume } from '../utils/units';
import { Drink } from '../types/drink';
import { useFocusEffect } from '@react-navigation/native';

export default function TodayScreen() {
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState<PresetDrink[]>([]);
  const [modalVisible, setModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [newType, setNewType] = useState<PresetDrink['beverageType']>('beer');
  const [newVolume, setNewVolume] = useState('500');
  const [newAbv, setNewAbv] = useState('5');

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const favs = await getFavoritePresets();
      setFavorites(favs);
    })();
  }, []);

  const presets = useMemo(() => {
    return [...defaultPresets, ...favorites];
  }, [favorites]);

  const [qtyModal, setQtyModal] = useState<{ visible: boolean; preset: PresetDrink | null; qty: string }>({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const openQtyModal = (preset: PresetDrink) => {
    setQtyModal({ visible: true, preset, qty: '1' });
  };

  const closeQtyModal = () => setQtyModal({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const confirmAddWithQty = async () => {
    if (!qtyModal.preset) return;
    const qtyNum = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(qtyModal.qty) || 1));
    const baseUnits = calculateStandardUnits(qtyModal.preset.volumeMl, qtyModal.preset.abvPercent);
    const totalUnits = Math.round(baseUnits * qtyNum * 100) / 100;
    const entry: Drink = {
      id: `drink_${Date.now()}`,
      dateISO: todayISO(),
      name: qtyModal.preset.name,
      beverageType: qtyModal.preset.beverageType,
      volumeMl: qtyModal.preset.volumeMl,
      abvPercent: qtyModal.preset.abvPercent,
      standardUnits: totalUnits,
      quantity: qtyNum,
    };
    await addOrMergeDrink(entry);
    closeQtyModal();
    Alert.alert('Добавлено', `${qtyModal.preset.name}: ${qtyNum} ед. (~${totalUnits} std)`);
    await reloadToday();
  };

  const openAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(true);
  const closeAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(false);

  const saveFavorite = async () => {
    const volume = parseFloat(newVolume);
    const abv = parseFloat(newAbv);
    if (!newName || isNaN(volume) || isNaN(abv)) {
      Alert.alert('Ошибка', 'Заполните название, объём и крепость');
      return;
    }
    const updated = await addFavoritePreset({
      name: newName,
      beverageType: newType,
      volumeMl: volume,
      abvPercent: abv,
    });
    setFavorites(updated);
    setNewName('');
    setNewType('beer');
    setNewVolume('500');
    setNewAbv('5');
    closeAddFavorite();
  };

  const [todayList, setTodayList] = useState<Drink[]>([]);
  const totalUnits = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.standardUnits, 0), [todayList]);
  const totalVolumeMl = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.volumeMl * (d.quantity ?? 1), 0), [todayList]);

  const reloadToday = useCallback(async () => {
    const list = await getDrinksByDate(todayISO());
    setTodayList(list);
  }, []);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      reloadToday();
    }, [reloadToday])
  );

  const onRemoveDrink = async (id: string) => {
    Alert.alert('Удалить запись?', 'Это действие нельзя отменить', [
      { text: 'Отмена', style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: 'Удалить',
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: async () => {
          await removeDrink(id);
          await reloadToday();
        },
      },
    ]);
  };

  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setEditMode(true);
  };

  const onRemoveFavorite = async (id: string) => {
    const updated = await removeFavoritePreset(id);
    setFavorites(updated);
    setEditMode(false);
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Text style={styles.title}>Сегодня</Text>
      <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Быстрые пресеты</Text>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.presetList}>
        {presets.map((p) => {
          const isFav = p.id.startsWith('fav_');
          return (
            <View key={p.id} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.presetButton}
                onPress={() => !editMode && openQtyModal(p)}
                onLongPress={handleLongPress}
                delayLongPress={500}
              >
                <Text style={styles.presetText}>{p.name}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              {isFav && editMode && (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  style={styles.removeFav}
                  onPress={() => onRemoveFavorite(p.id)}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.removeFavText}>×</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
            </View>
          );
        })}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.addFavButtonRect}
          onPress={() => {
            setEditMode(false);
            openAddFavorite();
          }}
          accessibilityLabel="Добавить любимый"
        >
          <Text style={styles.addFavRectText}>+</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>

      <View style={styles.sectionHeaderRow}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Сегодняшние записи</Text>
        <View style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
          <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {formatTotalVolume(totalVolumeMl, 1)}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {totalUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
      <FlatList
        data={todayList}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View style={styles.listItem}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.itemTitle}>{item.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.itemSub}>
                {formatTotalVolume(item.volumeMl, item.quantity ?? 1)} · {item.abvPercent}% · {item.standardUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.
                {item.quantity && item.quantity > 1 ? ` (x${item.quantity})` : ''}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => onRemoveDrink(item.id)} style={styles.deleteBtn}>
              <Text style={styles.deleteText}>Удалить</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}
        ListEmptyComponent={<Text style={{ color: '#666' }}>Пока нет записей за сегодня</Text>}
        contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 24 }}
      />

      {/* Модалка количества единиц перед добавлением */}
      <Modal visible={qtyModal.visible} animationType="fade" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.centerBackdrop}>
            <View style={styles.centerCard}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Сколько единиц?</Text>
              {qtyModal.preset && (
                <Text style={{ marginBottom: 8, color: '#666' }}>{qtyModal.preset.name}</Text>
              )}
              <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String(Math.max(1, (parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) - 1)) }))}
                  style={[styles.cancelBtn, { marginRight: 8 }]}
                >
                  <Text>-</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TextInput
                  value={qtyModal.qty}
                  onChangeText={(t) => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: t.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') }))}
                  keyboardType="number-pad"
                  style={[styles.input, { width: 100, textAlign: 'center' }]}
                  returnKeyType="done"
                  onSubmitEditing={confirmAddWithQty}
                />
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String((parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) + 1) }))}
                  style={[styles.saveBtn, { marginLeft: 8, backgroundColor: '#eee' }]}
                >
                  <Text>+</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeQtyModal}>
                  <Text>Отмена</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={confirmAddWithQty}>
                  <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Добавить</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>

      <Modal visible={modalVisible} animationType="slide" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
            <KeyboardAvoidingView
              behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
              keyboardVerticalOffset={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 64 : 0}
              style={styles.kav}
            >
              <View style={styles.modalCard}>
                <ScrollView keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
                  <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Новый любимый напиток</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    placeholder="Название (например, Пиво 500 мл)"
                    placeholderTextColor="#888"
                    value={newName}
                    onChangeText={setNewName}
                    style={styles.input}
                    returnKeyType="done"
                    blurOnSubmit
                    onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                  />
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <Text style={styles.label}>Тип:</Text>
                    <View style={styles.typeRow}>
                      {(['beer','wine','spirit','cocktail','other'] as const).map((t) => (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          key={t}
                          style={[styles.typeChip, newType === t && styles.typeChipActive]}
                          onPress={() => setNewType(t)}
                        >
                          <Text style={styles.typeChipText}>{t}</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      ))}
                    </View>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Объём, мл"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newVolume}
                      onChangeText={setNewVolume}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1, marginRight: 8 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Крепость, %"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newAbv}
                      onChangeText={setNewAbv}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeAddFavorite}>
                      <Text>Отмена</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={saveFavorite}>
                      <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Сохранить</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
                </ScrollView>
              </View>
            </KeyboardAvoidingView>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}
```

Восстанавливаю стили для красного крестика и удаляю ненужные стили drag-and-drop:


```typescriptreact
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Modal, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, Alert, FlatList, TouchableWithoutFeedback, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, Keyboard } from 'react-native';
import PresetButton from '../components/PresetButton';
import { defaultPresets, getFavoritePresets, addFavoritePreset, removeFavoritePreset } from '../storage/presets';
import { PresetDrink } from '../types/preset';
import { addDrink, addOrMergeDrink, getDrinksByDate, removeDrink } from '../storage/drinks';
import { calculateStandardUnits, todayISO, formatTotalVolume } from '../utils/units';
import { Drink } from '../types/drink';
import { useFocusEffect } from '@react-navigation/native';

export default function TodayScreen() {
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState<PresetDrink[]>([]);
  const [modalVisible, setModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [newType, setNewType] = useState<PresetDrink['beverageType']>('beer');
  const [newVolume, setNewVolume] = useState('500');
  const [newAbv, setNewAbv] = useState('5');

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const favs = await getFavoritePresets();
      setFavorites(favs);
    })();
  }, []);

  const presets = useMemo(() => {
    return [...defaultPresets, ...favorites];
  }, [favorites]);

  const [qtyModal, setQtyModal] = useState<{ visible: boolean; preset: PresetDrink | null; qty: string }>({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const openQtyModal = (preset: PresetDrink) => {
    setQtyModal({ visible: true, preset, qty: '1' });
  };

  const closeQtyModal = () => setQtyModal({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const confirmAddWithQty = async () => {
    if (!qtyModal.preset) return;
    const qtyNum = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(qtyModal.qty) || 1));
    const baseUnits = calculateStandardUnits(qtyModal.preset.volumeMl, qtyModal.preset.abvPercent);
    const totalUnits = Math.round(baseUnits * qtyNum * 100) / 100;
    const entry: Drink = {
      id: `drink_${Date.now()}`,
      dateISO: todayISO(),
      name: qtyModal.preset.name,
      beverageType: qtyModal.preset.beverageType,
      volumeMl: qtyModal.preset.volumeMl,
      abvPercent: qtyModal.preset.abvPercent,
      standardUnits: totalUnits,
      quantity: qtyNum,
    };
    await addOrMergeDrink(entry);
    closeQtyModal();
    Alert.alert('Добавлено', `${qtyModal.preset.name}: ${qtyNum} ед. (~${totalUnits} std)`);
    await reloadToday();
  };

  const openAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(true);
  const closeAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(false);

  const saveFavorite = async () => {
    const volume = parseFloat(newVolume);
    const abv = parseFloat(newAbv);
    if (!newName || isNaN(volume) || isNaN(abv)) {
      Alert.alert('Ошибка', 'Заполните название, объём и крепость');
      return;
    }
    const updated = await addFavoritePreset({
      name: newName,
      beverageType: newType,
      volumeMl: volume,
      abvPercent: abv,
    });
    setFavorites(updated);
    setNewName('');
    setNewType('beer');
    setNewVolume('500');
    setNewAbv('5');
    closeAddFavorite();
  };

  const [todayList, setTodayList] = useState<Drink[]>([]);
  const totalUnits = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.standardUnits, 0), [todayList]);
  const totalVolumeMl = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.volumeMl * (d.quantity ?? 1), 0), [todayList]);

  const reloadToday = useCallback(async () => {
    const list = await getDrinksByDate(todayISO());
    setTodayList(list);
  }, []);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      reloadToday();
    }, [reloadToday])
  );

  const onRemoveDrink = async (id: string) => {
    Alert.alert('Удалить запись?', 'Это действие нельзя отменить', [
      { text: 'Отмена', style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: 'Удалить',
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: async () => {
          await removeDrink(id);
          await reloadToday();
        },
      },
    ]);
  };

  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setEditMode(true);
  };

  const onRemoveFavorite = async (id: string) => {
    const updated = await removeFavoritePreset(id);
    setFavorites(updated);
    setEditMode(false);
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Text style={styles.title}>Сегодня</Text>
      <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Быстрые пресеты</Text>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.presetList}>
        {presets.map((p) => {
          const isFav = p.id.startsWith('fav_');
          return (
            <View key={p.id} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.presetButton}
                onPress={() => !editMode && openQtyModal(p)}
                onLongPress={handleLongPress}
                delayLongPress={500}
              >
                <Text style={styles.presetText}>{p.name}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              {isFav && editMode && (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  style={styles.removeFav}
                  onPress={() => onRemoveFavorite(p.id)}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.removeFavText}>×</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
            </View>
          );
        })}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.addFavButtonRect}
          onPress={() => {
            setEditMode(false);
            openAddFavorite();
          }}
          accessibilityLabel="Добавить любимый"
        >
          <Text style={styles.addFavRectText}>+</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>

      <View style={styles.sectionHeaderRow}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Сегодняшние записи</Text>
        <View style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
          <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {formatTotalVolume(totalVolumeMl, 1)}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {totalUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
      <FlatList
        data={todayList}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View style={styles.listItem}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.itemTitle}>{item.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.itemSub}>
                {formatTotalVolume(item.volumeMl, item.quantity ?? 1)} · {item.abvPercent}% · {item.standardUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.
                {item.quantity && item.quantity > 1 ? ` (x${item.quantity})` : ''}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => onRemoveDrink(item.id)} style={styles.deleteBtn}>
              <Text style={styles.deleteText}>Удалить</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}
        ListEmptyComponent={<Text style={{ color: '#666' }}>Пока нет записей за сегодня</Text>}
        contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 24 }}
      />

      {/* Модалка количества единиц перед добавлением */}
      <Modal visible={qtyModal.visible} animationType="fade" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.centerBackdrop}>
            <View style={styles.centerCard}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Сколько единиц?</Text>
              {qtyModal.preset && (
                <Text style={{ marginBottom: 8, color: '#666' }}>{qtyModal.preset.name}</Text>
              )}
              <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String(Math.max(1, (parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) - 1)) }))}
                  style={[styles.cancelBtn, { marginRight: 8 }]}
                >
                  <Text>-</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TextInput
                  value={qtyModal.qty}
                  onChangeText={(t) => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: t.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') }))}
                  keyboardType="number-pad"
                  style={[styles.input, { width: 100, textAlign: 'center' }]}
                  returnKeyType="done"
                  onSubmitEditing={confirmAddWithQty}
                />
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String((parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) + 1) }))}
                  style={[styles.saveBtn, { marginLeft: 8, backgroundColor: '#eee' }]}
                >
                  <Text>+</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeQtyModal}>
                  <Text>Отмена</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={confirmAddWithQty}>
                  <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Добавить</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>

      <Modal visible={modalVisible} animationType="slide" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
            <KeyboardAvoidingView
              behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
              keyboardVerticalOffset={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 64 : 0}
              style={styles.kav}
            >
              <View style={styles.modalCard}>
                <ScrollView keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
                  <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Новый любимый напиток</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    placeholder="Название (например, Пиво 500 мл)"
                    placeholderTextColor="#888"
                    value={newName}
                    onChangeText={setNewName}
                    style={styles.input}
                    returnKeyType="done"
                    blurOnSubmit
                    onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                  />
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <Text style={styles.label}>Тип:</Text>
                    <View style={styles.typeRow}>
                      {(['beer','wine','spirit','cocktail','other'] as const).map((t) => (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          key={t}
                          style={[styles.typeChip, newType === t && styles.typeChipActive]}
                          onPress={() => setNewType(t)}
                        >
                          <Text style={styles.typeChipText}>{t}</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      ))}
                    </View>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Объём, мл"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newVolume}
                      onChangeText={setNewVolume}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1, marginRight: 8 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Крепость, %"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newAbv}
                      onChangeText={setNewAbv}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeAddFavorite}>
                      <Text>Отмена</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={saveFavorite}>
                      <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Сохранить</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
                </ScrollView>
              </View>
            </KeyboardAvoidingView>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}
```

Добавляю выход из режима редактирования при тапе вне пресетов:


```typescriptreact
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Modal, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, Alert, FlatList, TouchableWithoutFeedback, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, Keyboard } from 'react-native';
import PresetButton from '../components/PresetButton';
import { defaultPresets, getFavoritePresets, addFavoritePreset, removeFavoritePreset } from '../storage/presets';
import { PresetDrink } from '../types/preset';
import { addDrink, addOrMergeDrink, getDrinksByDate, removeDrink } from '../storage/drinks';
import { calculateStandardUnits, todayISO, formatTotalVolume } from '../utils/units';
import { Drink } from '../types/drink';
import { useFocusEffect } from '@react-navigation/native';

export default function TodayScreen() {
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState<PresetDrink[]>([]);
  const [modalVisible, setModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [newType, setNewType] = useState<PresetDrink['beverageType']>('beer');
  const [newVolume, setNewVolume] = useState('500');
  const [newAbv, setNewAbv] = useState('5');

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const favs = await getFavoritePresets();
      setFavorites(favs);
    })();
  }, []);

  const presets = useMemo(() => {
    return [...defaultPresets, ...favorites];
  }, [favorites]);

  const [qtyModal, setQtyModal] = useState<{ visible: boolean; preset: PresetDrink | null; qty: string }>({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const openQtyModal = (preset: PresetDrink) => {
    setQtyModal({ visible: true, preset, qty: '1' });
  };

  const closeQtyModal = () => setQtyModal({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const confirmAddWithQty = async () => {
    if (!qtyModal.preset) return;
    const qtyNum = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(qtyModal.qty) || 1));
    const baseUnits = calculateStandardUnits(qtyModal.preset.volumeMl, qtyModal.preset.abvPercent);
    const totalUnits = Math.round(baseUnits * qtyNum * 100) / 100;
    const entry: Drink = {
      id: `drink_${Date.now()}`,
      dateISO: todayISO(),
      name: qtyModal.preset.name,
      beverageType: qtyModal.preset.beverageType,
      volumeMl: qtyModal.preset.volumeMl,
      abvPercent: qtyModal.preset.abvPercent,
      standardUnits: totalUnits,
      quantity: qtyNum,
    };
    await addOrMergeDrink(entry);
    closeQtyModal();
    Alert.alert('Добавлено', `${qtyModal.preset.name}: ${qtyNum} ед. (~${totalUnits} std)`);
    await reloadToday();
  };

  const openAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(true);
  const closeAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(false);

  const saveFavorite = async () => {
    const volume = parseFloat(newVolume);
    const abv = parseFloat(newAbv);
    if (!newName || isNaN(volume) || isNaN(abv)) {
      Alert.alert('Ошибка', 'Заполните название, объём и крепость');
      return;
    }
    const updated = await addFavoritePreset({
      name: newName,
      beverageType: newType,
      volumeMl: volume,
      abvPercent: abv,
    });
    setFavorites(updated);
    setNewName('');
    setNewType('beer');
    setNewVolume('500');
    setNewAbv('5');
    closeAddFavorite();
  };

  const [todayList, setTodayList] = useState<Drink[]>([]);
  const totalUnits = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.standardUnits, 0), [todayList]);
  const totalVolumeMl = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.volumeMl * (d.quantity ?? 1), 0), [todayList]);

  const reloadToday = useCallback(async () => {
    const list = await getDrinksByDate(todayISO());
    setTodayList(list);
  }, []);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      reloadToday();
    }, [reloadToday])
  );

  const onRemoveDrink = async (id: string) => {
    Alert.alert('Удалить запись?', 'Это действие нельзя отменить', [
      { text: 'Отмена', style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: 'Удалить',
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: async () => {
          await removeDrink(id);
          await reloadToday();
        },
      },
    ]);
  };

  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setEditMode(true);
  };

  const onRemoveFavorite = async (id: string) => {
    const updated = await removeFavoritePreset(id);
    setFavorites(updated);
    setEditMode(false);
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Text style={styles.title}>Сегодня</Text>
      <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Быстрые пресеты</Text>
      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={1}
        onPress={() => editMode && setEditMode(false)}
        style={{ flex: 0 }}
      >
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.presetList}>
        {presets.map((p) => {
          const isFav = p.id.startsWith('fav_');
          return (
            <View key={p.id} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.presetButton}
                onPress={() => !editMode && openQtyModal(p)}
                onLongPress={handleLongPress}
                delayLongPress={500}
              >
                <Text style={styles.presetText}>{p.name}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              {isFav && editMode && (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  style={styles.removeFav}
                  onPress={() => onRemoveFavorite(p.id)}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.removeFavText}>×</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
            </View>
          );
        })}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.addFavButtonRect}
          onPress={() => {
            setEditMode(false);
            openAddFavorite();
          }}
          accessibilityLabel="Добавить любимый"
        >
          <Text style={styles.addFavRectText}>+</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>

      <View style={styles.sectionHeaderRow}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Сегодняшние записи</Text>
        <View style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
          <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {formatTotalVolume(totalVolumeMl, 1)}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {totalUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
      <FlatList
        data={todayList}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View style={styles.listItem}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.itemTitle}>{item.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.itemSub}>
                {formatTotalVolume(item.volumeMl, item.quantity ?? 1)} · {item.abvPercent}% · {item.standardUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.
                {item.quantity && item.quantity > 1 ? ` (x${item.quantity})` : ''}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => onRemoveDrink(item.id)} style={styles.deleteBtn}>
              <Text style={styles.deleteText}>Удалить</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}
        ListEmptyComponent={<Text style={{ color: '#666' }}>Пока нет записей за сегодня</Text>}
        contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 24 }}
      />

      {/* Модалка количества единиц перед добавлением */}
      <Modal visible={qtyModal.visible} animationType="fade" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.centerBackdrop}>
            <View style={styles.centerCard}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Сколько единиц?</Text>
              {qtyModal.preset && (
                <Text style={{ marginBottom: 8, color: '#666' }}>{qtyModal.preset.name}</Text>
              )}
              <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String(Math.max(1, (parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) - 1)) }))}
                  style={[styles.cancelBtn, { marginRight: 8 }]}
                >
                  <Text>-</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TextInput
                  value={qtyModal.qty}
                  onChangeText={(t) => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: t.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') }))}
                  keyboardType="number-pad"
                  style={[styles.input, { width: 100, textAlign: 'center' }]}
                  returnKeyType="done"
                  onSubmitEditing={confirmAddWithQty}
                />
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String((parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) + 1) }))}
                  style={[styles.saveBtn, { marginLeft: 8, backgroundColor: '#eee' }]}
                >
                  <Text>+</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeQtyModal}>
                  <Text>Отмена</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={confirmAddWithQty}>
                  <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Добавить</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>

      <Modal visible={modalVisible} animationType="slide" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
            <KeyboardAvoidingView
              behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
              keyboardVerticalOffset={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 64 : 0}
              style={styles.kav}
            >
              <View style={styles.modalCard}>
                <ScrollView keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
                  <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Новый любимый напиток</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    placeholder="Название (например, Пиво 500 мл)"
                    placeholderTextColor="#888"
                    value={newName}
                    onChangeText={setNewName}
                    style={styles.input}
                    returnKeyType="done"
                    blurOnSubmit
                    onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                  />
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <Text style={styles.label}>Тип:</Text>
                    <View style={styles.typeRow}>
                      {(['beer','wine','spirit','cocktail','other'] as const).map((t) => (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          key={t}
                          style={[styles.typeChip, newType === t && styles.typeChipActive]}
                          onPress={() => setNewType(t)}
                        >
                          <Text style={styles.typeChipText}>{t}</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      ))}
                    </View>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Объём, мл"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newVolume}
                      onChangeText={setNewVolume}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1, marginRight: 8 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Крепость, %"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newAbv}
                      onChangeText={setNewAbv}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeAddFavorite}>
                      <Text>Отмена</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={saveFavorite}>
                      <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Сохранить</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
                </ScrollView>
              </View>
            </KeyboardAvoidingView>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Modal, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, Alert, FlatList, TouchableWithoutFeedback, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, Keyboard } from 'react-native';
import PresetButton from '../components/PresetButton';
import { defaultPresets, getFavoritePresets, addFavoritePreset, removeFavoritePreset } from '../storage/presets';
import { PresetDrink } from '../types/preset';
import { addDrink, addOrMergeDrink, getDrinksByDate, removeDrink } from '../storage/drinks';
import { calculateStandardUnits, todayISO, formatTotalVolume } from '../utils/units';
import { Drink } from '../types/drink';
import { useFocusEffect } from '@react-navigation/native';

export default function TodayScreen() {
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState<PresetDrink[]>([]);
  const [modalVisible, setModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [newType, setNewType] = useState<PresetDrink['beverageType']>('beer');
  const [newVolume, setNewVolume] = useState('500');
  const [newAbv, setNewAbv] = useState('5');

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const favs = await getFavoritePresets();
      setFavorites(favs);
    })();
  }, []);

  const presets = useMemo(() => {
    return [...defaultPresets, ...favorites];
  }, [favorites]);

  const [qtyModal, setQtyModal] = useState<{ visible: boolean; preset: PresetDrink | null; qty: string }>({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const openQtyModal = (preset: PresetDrink) => {
    setQtyModal({ visible: true, preset, qty: '1' });
  };

  const closeQtyModal = () => setQtyModal({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const confirmAddWithQty = async () => {
    if (!qtyModal.preset) return;
    const qtyNum = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(qtyModal.qty) || 1));
    const baseUnits = calculateStandardUnits(qtyModal.preset.volumeMl, qtyModal.preset.abvPercent);
    const totalUnits = Math.round(baseUnits * qtyNum * 100) / 100;
    const entry: Drink = {
      id: `drink_${Date.now()}`,
      dateISO: todayISO(),
      name: qtyModal.preset.name,
      beverageType: qtyModal.preset.beverageType,
      volumeMl: qtyModal.preset.volumeMl,
      abvPercent: qtyModal.preset.abvPercent,
      standardUnits: totalUnits,
      quantity: qtyNum,
    };
    await addOrMergeDrink(entry);
    closeQtyModal();
    Alert.alert('Добавлено', `${qtyModal.preset.name}: ${qtyNum} ед. (~${totalUnits} std)`);
    await reloadToday();
  };

  const openAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(true);
  const closeAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(false);

  const saveFavorite = async () => {
    const volume = parseFloat(newVolume);
    const abv = parseFloat(newAbv);
    if (!newName || isNaN(volume) || isNaN(abv)) {
      Alert.alert('Ошибка', 'Заполните название, объём и крепость');
      return;
    }
    const updated = await addFavoritePreset({
      name: newName,
      beverageType: newType,
      volumeMl: volume,
      abvPercent: abv,
    });
    setFavorites(updated);
    setNewName('');
    setNewType('beer');
    setNewVolume('500');
    setNewAbv('5');
    closeAddFavorite();
  };

  const [todayList, setTodayList] = useState<Drink[]>([]);
  const totalUnits = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.standardUnits, 0), [todayList]);
  const totalVolumeMl = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.volumeMl * (d.quantity ?? 1), 0), [todayList]);

  const reloadToday = useCallback(async () => {
    const list = await getDrinksByDate(todayISO());
    setTodayList(list);
  }, []);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      reloadToday();
    }, [reloadToday])
  );

  const onRemoveDrink = async (id: string) => {
    Alert.alert('Удалить запись?', 'Это действие нельзя отменить', [
      { text: 'Отмена', style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: 'Удалить',
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: async () => {
          await removeDrink(id);
          await reloadToday();
        },
      },
    ]);
  };

  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setEditMode(true);
  };

  const onRemoveFavorite = async (id: string) => {
    const updated = await removeFavoritePreset(id);
    setFavorites(updated);
    setEditMode(false);
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Text style={styles.title}>Сегодня</Text>
      <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Быстрые пресеты</Text>
      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={1}
        onPress={() => editMode && setEditMode(false)}
        style={{ flex: 0 }}
      >
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.presetList}>
        {presets.map((p) => {
          const isFav = p.id.startsWith('fav_');
          return (
            <View key={p.id} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.presetButton}
                onPress={() => !editMode && openQtyModal(p)}
                onLongPress={handleLongPress}
                delayLongPress={500}
              >
                <Text style={styles.presetText}>{p.name}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              {isFav && editMode && (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  style={styles.removeFav}
                  onPress={() => onRemoveFavorite(p.id)}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.removeFavText}>×</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
            </View>
          );
        })}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.addFavButtonRect}
          onPress={() => {
            setEditMode(false);
            openAddFavorite();
          }}
          accessibilityLabel="Добавить любимый"
        >
          <Text style={styles.addFavRectText}>+</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        </ScrollView>
      </TouchableOpacity>

      <View style={styles.sectionHeaderRow}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Сегодняшние записи</Text>
        <View style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
          <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {formatTotalVolume(totalVolumeMl, 1)}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {totalUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
      <FlatList
        data={todayList}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View style={styles.listItem}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.itemTitle}>{item.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.itemSub}>
                {formatTotalVolume(item.volumeMl, item.quantity ?? 1)} · {item.abvPercent}% · {item.standardUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.
                {item.quantity && item.quantity > 1 ? ` (x${item.quantity})` : ''}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => onRemoveDrink(item.id)} style={styles.deleteBtn}>
              <Text style={styles.deleteText}>Удалить</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}
        ListEmptyComponent={<Text style={{ color: '#666' }}>Пока нет записей за сегодня</Text>}
        contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 24 }}
      />

      {/* Модалка количества единиц перед добавлением */}
      <Modal visible={qtyModal.visible} animationType="fade" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.centerBackdrop}>
            <View style={styles.centerCard}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Сколько единиц?</Text>
              {qtyModal.preset && (
                <Text style={{ marginBottom: 8, color: '#666' }}>{qtyModal.preset.name}</Text>
              )}
              <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String(Math.max(1, (parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) - 1)) }))}
                  style={[styles.cancelBtn, { marginRight: 8 }]}
                >
                  <Text>-</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TextInput
                  value={qtyModal.qty}
                  onChangeText={(t) => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: t.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') }))}
                  keyboardType="number-pad"
                  style={[styles.input, { width: 100, textAlign: 'center' }]}
                  returnKeyType="done"
                  onSubmitEditing={confirmAddWithQty}
                />
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String((parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) + 1) }))}
                  style={[styles.saveBtn, { marginLeft: 8, backgroundColor: '#eee' }]}
                >
                  <Text>+</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeQtyModal}>
                  <Text>Отмена</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={confirmAddWithQty}>
                  <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Добавить</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>

      <Modal visible={modalVisible} animationType="slide" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
            <KeyboardAvoidingView
              behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
              keyboardVerticalOffset={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 64 : 0}
              style={styles.kav}
            >
              <View style={styles.modalCard}>
                <ScrollView keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
                  <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Новый любимый напиток</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    placeholder="Название (например, Пиво 500 мл)"
                    placeholderTextColor="#888"
                    value={newName}
                    onChangeText={setNewName}
                    style={styles.input}
                    returnKeyType="done"
                    blurOnSubmit
                    onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                  />
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <Text style={styles.label}>Тип:</Text>
                    <View style={styles.typeRow}>
                      {(['beer','wine','spirit','cocktail','other'] as const).map((t) => (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          key={t}
                          style={[styles.typeChip, newType === t && styles.typeChipActive]}
                          onPress={() => setNewType(t)}
                        >
                          <Text style={styles.typeChipText}>{t}</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      ))}
                    </View>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Объём, мл"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newVolume}
                      onChangeText={setNewVolume}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1, marginRight: 8 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Крепость, %"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newAbv}
                      onChangeText={setNewAbv}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeAddFavorite}>
                      <Text>Отмена</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={saveFavorite}>
                      <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Сохранить</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
                </ScrollView>
              </View>
            </KeyboardAvoidingView>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}
```

Добавляю выход из режима редактирования при тапе на область записей:


```typescriptreact
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Modal, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, Alert, FlatList, TouchableWithoutFeedback, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, Keyboard } from 'react-native';
import PresetButton from '../components/PresetButton';
import { defaultPresets, getFavoritePresets, addFavoritePreset, removeFavoritePreset } from '../storage/presets';
import { PresetDrink } from '../types/preset';
import { addDrink, addOrMergeDrink, getDrinksByDate, removeDrink } from '../storage/drinks';
import { calculateStandardUnits, todayISO, formatTotalVolume } from '../utils/units';
import { Drink } from '../types/drink';
import { useFocusEffect } from '@react-navigation/native';

export default function TodayScreen() {
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState<PresetDrink[]>([]);
  const [modalVisible, setModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [newType, setNewType] = useState<PresetDrink['beverageType']>('beer');
  const [newVolume, setNewVolume] = useState('500');
  const [newAbv, setNewAbv] = useState('5');

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const favs = await getFavoritePresets();
      setFavorites(favs);
    })();
  }, []);

  const presets = useMemo(() => {
    return [...defaultPresets, ...favorites];
  }, [favorites]);

  const [qtyModal, setQtyModal] = useState<{ visible: boolean; preset: PresetDrink | null; qty: string }>({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const openQtyModal = (preset: PresetDrink) => {
    setQtyModal({ visible: true, preset, qty: '1' });
  };

  const closeQtyModal = () => setQtyModal({ visible: false, preset: null, qty: '1' });

  const confirmAddWithQty = async () => {
    if (!qtyModal.preset) return;
    const qtyNum = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(qtyModal.qty) || 1));
    const baseUnits = calculateStandardUnits(qtyModal.preset.volumeMl, qtyModal.preset.abvPercent);
    const totalUnits = Math.round(baseUnits * qtyNum * 100) / 100;
    const entry: Drink = {
      id: `drink_${Date.now()}`,
      dateISO: todayISO(),
      name: qtyModal.preset.name,
      beverageType: qtyModal.preset.beverageType,
      volumeMl: qtyModal.preset.volumeMl,
      abvPercent: qtyModal.preset.abvPercent,
      standardUnits: totalUnits,
      quantity: qtyNum,
    };
    await addOrMergeDrink(entry);
    closeQtyModal();
    Alert.alert('Добавлено', `${qtyModal.preset.name}: ${qtyNum} ед. (~${totalUnits} std)`);
    await reloadToday();
  };

  const openAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(true);
  const closeAddFavorite = () => setModalVisible(false);

  const saveFavorite = async () => {
    const volume = parseFloat(newVolume);
    const abv = parseFloat(newAbv);
    if (!newName || isNaN(volume) || isNaN(abv)) {
      Alert.alert('Ошибка', 'Заполните название, объём и крепость');
      return;
    }
    const updated = await addFavoritePreset({
      name: newName,
      beverageType: newType,
      volumeMl: volume,
      abvPercent: abv,
    });
    setFavorites(updated);
    setNewName('');
    setNewType('beer');
    setNewVolume('500');
    setNewAbv('5');
    closeAddFavorite();
  };

  const [todayList, setTodayList] = useState<Drink[]>([]);
  const totalUnits = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.standardUnits, 0), [todayList]);
  const totalVolumeMl = useMemo(() => todayList.reduce((s, d) => s + d.volumeMl * (d.quantity ?? 1), 0), [todayList]);

  const reloadToday = useCallback(async () => {
    const list = await getDrinksByDate(todayISO());
    setTodayList(list);
  }, []);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      reloadToday();
    }, [reloadToday])
  );

  const onRemoveDrink = async (id: string) => {
    Alert.alert('Удалить запись?', 'Это действие нельзя отменить', [
      { text: 'Отмена', style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: 'Удалить',
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: async () => {
          await removeDrink(id);
          await reloadToday();
        },
      },
    ]);
  };

  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setEditMode(true);
  };

  const onRemoveFavorite = async (id: string) => {
    const updated = await removeFavoritePreset(id);
    setFavorites(updated);
    setEditMode(false);
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Text style={styles.title}>Сегодня</Text>
      <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Быстрые пресеты</Text>
      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={1}
        onPress={() => editMode && setEditMode(false)}
        style={{ flex: 0 }}
      >
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.presetList}>
        {presets.map((p) => {
          const isFav = p.id.startsWith('fav_');
          return (
            <View key={p.id} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.presetButton}
                onPress={() => !editMode && openQtyModal(p)}
                onLongPress={handleLongPress}
                delayLongPress={500}
              >
                <Text style={styles.presetText}>{p.name}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              {isFav && editMode && (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  style={styles.removeFav}
                  onPress={() => onRemoveFavorite(p.id)}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.removeFavText}>×</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )}
            </View>
          );
        })}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.addFavButtonRect}
          onPress={() => {
            setEditMode(false);
            openAddFavorite();
          }}
          accessibilityLabel="Добавить любимый"
        >
          <Text style={styles.addFavRectText}>+</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        </ScrollView>
      </TouchableOpacity>

      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={1}
        onPress={() => editMode && setEditMode(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.sectionHeaderRow}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Сегодняшние записи</Text>
          <View style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
            <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {formatTotalVolume(totalVolumeMl, 1)}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.total}>всего: {totalUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </TouchableOpacity>
      <FlatList
        data={todayList}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View style={styles.listItem}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.itemTitle}>{item.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.itemSub}>
                {formatTotalVolume(item.volumeMl, item.quantity ?? 1)} · {item.abvPercent}% · {item.standardUnits.toFixed(2)} ед.
                {item.quantity && item.quantity > 1 ? ` (x${item.quantity})` : ''}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => onRemoveDrink(item.id)} style={styles.deleteBtn}>
              <Text style={styles.deleteText}>Удалить</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}
        ListEmptyComponent={<Text style={{ color: '#666' }}>Пока нет записей за сегодня</Text>}
        contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 24 }}
      />

      {/* Модалка количества единиц перед добавлением */}
      <Modal visible={qtyModal.visible} animationType="fade" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.centerBackdrop}>
            <View style={styles.centerCard}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Сколько единиц?</Text>
              {qtyModal.preset && (
                <Text style={{ marginBottom: 8, color: '#666' }}>{qtyModal.preset.name}</Text>
              )}
              <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String(Math.max(1, (parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) - 1)) }))}
                  style={[styles.cancelBtn, { marginRight: 8 }]}
                >
                  <Text>-</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TextInput
                  value={qtyModal.qty}
                  onChangeText={(t) => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: t.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') }))}
                  keyboardType="number-pad"
                  style={[styles.input, { width: 100, textAlign: 'center' }]}
                  returnKeyType="done"
                  onSubmitEditing={confirmAddWithQty}
                />
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setQtyModal((s) => ({ ...s, qty: String((parseInt(s.qty || '1', 10) || 1) + 1) }))}
                  style={[styles.saveBtn, { marginLeft: 8, backgroundColor: '#eee' }]}
                >
                  <Text>+</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeQtyModal}>
                  <Text>Отмена</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={confirmAddWithQty}>
                  <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Добавить</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>

      <Modal visible={modalVisible} animationType="slide" transparent>
        <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={Keyboard.dismiss}>
          <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
            <KeyboardAvoidingView
              behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
              keyboardVerticalOffset={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 64 : 0}
              style={styles.kav}
            >
              <View style={styles.modalCard}>
                <ScrollView keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
                  <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Новый любимый напиток</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    placeholder="Название (например, Пиво 500 мл)"
                    placeholderTextColor="#888"
                    value={newName}
                    onChangeText={setNewName}
                    style={styles.input}
                    returnKeyType="done"
                    blurOnSubmit
                    onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                  />
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <Text style={styles.label}>Тип:</Text>
                    <View style={styles.typeRow}>
                      {(['beer','wine','spirit','cocktail','other'] as const).map((t) => (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          key={t}
                          style={[styles.typeChip, newType === t && styles.typeChipActive]}
                          onPress={() => setNewType(t)}
                        >
                          <Text style={styles.typeChipText}>{t}</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      ))}
                    </View>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.row}>
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Объём, мл"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newVolume}
                      onChangeText={setNewVolume}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1, marginRight: 8 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                    <TextInput
                      placeholder="Крепость, %"
                      placeholderTextColor="#888"
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      value={newAbv}
                      onChangeText={setNewAbv}
                      style={[styles.input, { flex: 1 }]}
                      returnKeyType="done"
                      blurOnSubmit
                      onSubmitEditing={Keyboard.dismiss}
                    />
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={closeAddFavorite}>
                      <Text>Отмена</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={saveFavorite}>
                      <Text style={{ color: '#fff' }}>Сохранить</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
                </ScrollView>
              </View>
            </KeyboardAvoidingView>
          </View>
        </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}
```
